title: param-lineage SITL upgrades
description: What a PX4 release made of the parameters the previous tracked release stored, on in-place upgrades in software-in-the-loop simulation (data/sitl/<from>..<to>.json). Made with python -m paramlineage.sitl; see docs/DESIGN.md, "Behaviour verification".

format.description: Layout of this file. Changes when a field is added, renamed or removed.

airframe.description: The SITL airframe both releases started with.

compiler.description: Per tag, the first line of the C++ compiler's --version.

platform.description: Operating system and machine the runs were made on.

notes.description: What the results cover and what they do not.

set.description: The values the older release stored, as it stored them.

not_in_build.description: Parameters the run meant to set that the older build does not have.

storage.description: Import-order runs only: the elements at the end of the storage the newer release started on, in file order.

after.description: Watched parameters as the newer release had them after it started; null: the build does not have the parameter.

set_by_name.description: By-name run only: whether the newer release accepted each old name set by name.

old_saved.description: Everything the older release saved: the storage the newer one started on, unless the run is an import-order run.

new_saved.description: Everything the newer release saved after it started.

import_log.description: What the newer release's parameter code logged while it imported.

unsteady.description: Saved parameters whose value differs between the two control runs; not compared.

expected.description: From the translations and the control run; null where the import order decides and the translations do not say.

unexpected.description: Per run, saved values that differ from the control run without a stored value to explain them. Empty when the runs agree with the translations.
